title: BRO Soil Map of the Netherlands 1:50,000 — Soil areas (SGM)
description:
48,025 soil-area polygons of the national Soil Map of the Netherlands 1:50,000 (Bodemkaart, SGM), enriched here with the primary soil unit and main soil class. Produced under VRO; bronhouder Wageningen Environmental Research.

🤖 AI/Agent users: see llms.txt for field descriptions, query examples and usage tips.

links.title: BRO Soil Map of the Netherlands 1:50,000 — Soil areas (SGM) documentation

table:columns.name: maparea_collection
table:columns.description: Survey campaign / map collection the polygon belongs to.

table:columns.name: soilslope
table:columns.description: Slope class of the soil area (mostly 'Niet opgenomen').

table:columns.name: hoofdklasse
table:columns.description: Main soil class (mainsoilclassification), e.g. Podzolgronden, Zeekleigronden.

table:columns.name: bodemklasse
table:columns.description: Full soil classification text of the primary soil unit.

table:columns.name: legenda_url
table:columns.description: URL to the official soil-class legend entry.

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Feature geometry (WKB) in EPSG:28992 (Amersfoort / RD New).

table:columns.name: geom_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float, ymin: float, xmax: float, ymax: float>
table:columns.description: Per-feature bounding box struct for spatial filtering.
